exceptions.reason: 0.76.1 does not forward AbortSignal to submission/result calls; the SDK submission retry and raw error logging do not meet our no-replay and safe-log contract.
exceptions.removeWhen: Programmatic Genie proves single submission, bounded cancellation, sanitized errors, read-only retries and the 500-row contract through compatibility tests.

exceptions.reason: Private personal-state writes, null bindings, native scalar types, explicit driver transport and standalone CLI diagnostics retain @databricks/sql. AppKit leaves JSON_ARRAY scalar values as strings and parses JSON-looking STRING cells.
exceptions.removeWhen: AppKit preserves bound nulls, native scalar types, exact STRING values, private write semantics and diagnostic authentication.

exceptions.reason: AppKit resolves workspace identity even with only its server plugin. Demo injects a fail-closed client with two synthetic metadata responses.
exceptions.removeWhen: Upstream server-only startup supports offline mode without identity resolution.

exceptions.reason: 0.76.1 ignores profile when host is also passed. Local OAuth uses the existing named CLI token provider for each operation.
exceptions.removeWhen: Upstream supports named CLI U2M credentials, host verification and token refresh together.

exceptions.reason: AppKit extend() runs after JSON parsing and its raw-body hook cannot match dynamic IDs. A small server subclass installs express.raw before the upstream parser through serverApplication; the rest of the server stays upstream. Generic analytics and automatic UI recorder routes remain disabled.
exceptions.removeWhen: Upstream provides a public pre-parser middleware hook and route-exposure options with the same byte limits and UTF-8 semantics.
